item.title: Version 1.1.7 (macOS)
item.description:
v1.1.7 — ACM / DOI links

  • Paste an ACM Digital Library (dl.acm.org) or doi.org link in the search bar and hit Open to jump straight to the PDF in your browser
  • Publisher PDFs are behind a paywall/Cloudflare check, so the download runs in your browser (with your access) — then drag the PDF back in to import it

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
v1.1.0 — Auto-Update System

  • Auto-update checking via Sparkle 2
  • Update notification badge on settings icon
  • About section in Settings with version info
  • PDF viewer right-click context menu
  • Fix Google/GitHub OAuth in release builds
  • DMG installer with drag-to-Applications
